title: LLM medication-list proposal
description: What the extraction model is asked to return for one page of an outside medication list (sent by the sidecar as response_format.json_schema with strict: true). Values only, copied as printed: the drug as name, the strength as dose, the directions as frequency; anchor.py proves each row on the page. The patient name is compared with the chart and never stored. Every field is required and unknown is null.

page.description: 1-based page the value was read from, as labelled in the page markers of the document text.
